title: Baked Fish with Undhiyu Sauce
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired dish featuring baked fish in a rich undhiyu sauce, served with steamed white rice.

ingredients.name: Fish fillet
ingredients.notes: White fish such as cod or tilapia

ingredients.name: Indian spices
ingredients.notes: Blend of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: Rinse the fish fillet and pat it dry with paper towels.
Brush the fish with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place the fish on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the fish in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the fish is baking, heat the undhiyu sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.
Serve the baked fish with steamed white rice and a spoonful of undhiyu sauce.
Garnish with chopped cilantro or scallions, if desired.
